note.value:
Setup: Draw 6 Chaos Magic Cards.

Casting: Chaos Sorcerer have +1 to cast. Each Power Card spent adds a +1 to cast. 1 always fails, 6 always succeeds. If fails to cast (but not dispelled), roll on the Failing To Cast table.

Dispelling: Opponent may choose any spell to dispel chaos magic. Subtract 1 from the roll for every Power Card used in the casting. 1 always fails, 6 always succeeds.

Dispelling Enemy Magic: Choose any Chaos spell and roll equal to or above it's casting number, +1 per Power Card spent. If you fail to dispel, roll on the Failed to Cast table.

Replenishing Power: Start of Magic Phase may spend 1 or more Power Cards to increase Power Level to a max of 6.

Replenishing Cards: During End Phase replenish Power Level number of cards, up to a max of 6.

Failed to Cast: Roll once per Power Card used. 1: Chaos Sorceror consumed by the warp; 2-3: Chaos Sorceror: lose one Power Level; 4-6: No ill effects.
